create_get_higgs_problem: create a higgs detection problem with a fully connected graph of photons and labels
build_network_definition: build a graph neural network using jraph.RelationNetwork to detect higgs bosons from photon data
run_train: run training of a graph neural network on higgs boson detection with adam optimizer
generate_random_higgs_photons: generate random boosted higgs photon pairs with invariant mass of 125 GeV
generate_random_background_photon: generate a random background photon with energy between 20 and 120 GeV
